title: ChatKit Widgets
description: Combined schema for all ChatKit widget types

AreaSeries.description: An area series plotted from a numeric `dataKey`. Supports stacking and curves.
AreaSeries.title: AreaSeries

Badge.description: Small badge indicating status or categorization.
Badge.title: Badge

BarSeries.description: A bar series plotted from a numeric `dataKey`. Supports stacking.
BarSeries.title: BarSeries

Border.description: Border style definition for an edge.
Border.title: Border

Borders.description: Composite border configuration applied across edges.
Borders.title: Borders

Box.description: Generic flex container with direction control.
Box.title: Box

Button.description: Button component optionally wired to an action.
Button.title: Button

CardAction.description: Configuration for confirm/cancel actions within a card.
CardAction.title: CardAction

Chart.description: Data visualization component for simple bar/line/area charts.
Chart.title: Chart

DynamicWidgetComponent.description:
A widget component with a statically defined base shape but dynamically
defined additional fields loaded from a widget template or JSON schema.
DynamicWidgetComponent.title: DynamicWidgetComponent

EditableProps.description: Editable field options for text widgets.
EditableProps.title: EditableProps

Icon.description: Icon component referencing a built-in icon name.
Icon.title: Icon

Image.description: Image component with sizing and fitting controls.
Image.title: Image

Label.description: Form label associated with a field.
Label.title: Label

LineSeries.description: A line series plotted from a numeric `dataKey`. Supports curves.
LineSeries.title: LineSeries

Markdown.description: Widget rendering Markdown content, optionally streamed.
Markdown.title: Markdown

SelectOption.description: Selectable option used by the ``Select`` widget.
SelectOption.title: SelectOption

Spacer.description: Flexible spacer used to push content apart.
Spacer.title: Spacer

Spacing.description: Shorthand spacing values applied to a widget.
Spacing.title: Spacing

Text.description: Widget rendering plain text with typography controls.
Text.title: Text

ThemeColor.description: Color values for light and dark themes.
ThemeColor.title: ThemeColor

Transition.description: Wrapper enabling transitions for a child component.
Transition.title: Transition

WidgetStatusWithFavicon.description: Widget status representation using a favicon.
WidgetStatusWithFavicon.title: WidgetStatusWithFavicon

WidgetStatusWithIcon.description: Widget status representation using an icon.
WidgetStatusWithIcon.title: WidgetStatusWithIcon

XAxisConfig.description: Configuration object for the X axis.
XAxisConfig.title: XAxisConfig
